title: Norvane C24 installation and servicing manual
siting: Fit on a flat, non-combustible wall able to carry the full operating weight.
A compartment needs no ventilation provided the stated clearances are kept.

gasSupply.note: Size the supply for no more than 1 mbar pressure drop between meter and appliance at maximum rate.
gasSupply.typicalPipeSize: 22 mm for runs up to 20 m

systemRequirements: Flush and clean to BS 7593 and dose with inhibitor.
Fit a magnetic filter on the return.
Minimum system volume 40 litres for stable modulation.
Sealed system: filling link, 3 bar relief valve discharge to outside in 15 mm copper.
commissioning: Fill, vent and check for leaks; set cold pressure.
Purge the gas supply and carry out a tightness test.
Check inlet standing and working pressures.
Set the appliance code d.93 = 24 if a replacement PCB is fitted.
Run the auto-calibration (d.88 = 1) and verify CO2 at maximum and minimum rate.
Set maximum heating output (d.00) to the calculated heat loss.
Complete the commissioning record and register the warranty within 30 days.
